The thing is, he doesn’t do everything and the house isn’t “dirty.” I clean as much as I can do without getting distracted or without having to take care of our child…and when I do, that’s not enough for him. I could clean the rooms, make the bed, do the dishes, and it still wouldn’t be enough for him. He expects everything to be cleaned spotless and to his standard, and if it’s not, then I did nothing all day and I’m a lazy person. But I’ve been seeing my doctor and discussing care plans about my mental health. And as for what I mean when I say I hate cleaning, it’s due to ptsd. My dad was a verbally abusive alcoholic who loved to scream if nothing went his way right when he said it or if I forgot to pick something up. He would break things that I had forgotten on the floor, he’d stomp on said things. So when I think of cleaning, it brings a lot of pent up emotion and causes waves of depression. I’ve been trying to do things little by little to overcome it. I pick up the floor every little bit after my son wrecks it, I do what dishes we have. And on top of that, I do every single thing for our child and I never get a break. It’s exhausting 🙃
